fact: On 17 August 2025 Sovereignty Council member Lt Gen Ibrahim Jabir opened the civil registry, passports and traffic services centre in East Nile, Khartoum State, with the Minister of Interior, who said it was the fourth such public service centre opened in this phase as his ministry restored its services; the governor of Khartoum said the identity-documents office reopened after a two-year stoppage during which residents had gone to River Nile State and Karari locality. The text does not say how the record is made.
title: عضو مجلس السيادة الفريق إبراهيم جابر يفتتح مركز خدمات السجل المدني والمرور بشرق النيل
